text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury slipped to 48.51 percent from 48.56 percent at the last sale on December 10, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.38 million UAH 8.92 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 82,835 were competitive and 67,165 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 17.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 59.50 percent from 58.42 percent at the last sale on December 10, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 25.99 million UAH 6.48 million UAH
Actual amount raised 20.05 million UAH 5.02 million UAH
The central bank sold 259,930 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 233,890 were competitive and 26,040 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 17.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 61.45 percent from 60.86 percent at the last sale on December 10, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 22,260 hryvnia 1.34 million UAH
The central bank sold 325 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 112 were competitive and 213 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 17.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills was unchanged at 61.20 percent, the same as at the last sale on December 10, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold six T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, one was competitive and five were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 17.
